frozen_inputs.semantic_contract: persistent CRegiment, current CArmyRegiment, current CArmy stores, full-generation identities, seven-row composition and postwar cleanup semantics
spawn_army creates persistent CRegiment, writes exact bound WarID at +0x13C and keep flag at +0x142, then creates and finalizes CArmy/current regiments
production generic current reader and independent exact-generation cleanup reader; source attribution remains unavailable

persistent_regiment.composition: seven 0x24 rows from +0x18; owner ID row+0x08, ordinal row+0x0C, current CArmyRegimentID row+0x10

current_army.roster: CArmy+0x38 data / +0x44 count contains exact current CArmyRegimentID

exact_native_chain.cleanup: after exact WarID disappears, the independent reader double-samples the same three stable stores; destroyed requires every frozen persistent/current generation absent and no stale CArmy roster attachment

paired_boundary_contract.pre: the nonnegative observed_current_soldiers from one strict paused active-war observation, frozen immediately before a future termination action
paired_boundary_contract.current: identical to pre at the frozen checkpoint; it is not the authored or initial-spawn total
paired_boundary_contract.post: zero only when every frozen persistent and current full-generation ID is destroyed and no frozen CArmy has a stale attachment
paired_boundary_contract.loss: pre minus zero only for complete destroyed cleanup
paired_boundary_contract.still_alive: typed cleanup_still_alive; post and proven loss remain unavailable because survivor soldiers are not sampled by v1 cleanup
paired_boundary_contract.identity: same owner full CharacterID, WarID and ordered persistent/current/CArmy generation set across the frozen baseline and cleanup

next_live_entry: a future exclusive runner must freeze the production current observation, retain its exact generations, record one typed termination submission, then query cleanup on the first stable paused postwar frame; only that action-bound artifact may promote causality or a public loss field
